name: trf
description: Recurring UPI AutoPay donations for The Rupee Fund — a FOSS United Foundation program, on Cloudflare Workers + D1.
author: FOSS United Foundation

scripts.preview: PUBLIC_ALLOW_TEST_SITEKEY=true PUBLIC_TURNSTILE_SITEKEY=1x00000000000000000000AA astro build && wrangler dev --var TURNSTILE_HOSTNAMES:example.com --var TURNSTILE_ACTION: --var TURNSTILE_SECRET:1x0000000000000000000000000000000AA
scripts.preview:post-launch: PUBLIC_ALLOW_TEST_SITEKEY=true PUBLIC_LAUNCH_LIVE=true PUBLIC_TURNSTILE_SITEKEY=1x00000000000000000000AA astro build && wrangler dev --env post-launch --var TURNSTILE_HOSTNAMES:example.com --var TURNSTILE_ACTION: --port 8788 --var TURNSTILE_SECRET:1x0000000000000000000000000000000AA --var RZP_PLAN_10:plan_a --var RZP_PLAN_50:plan_b --var RZP_PLAN_100:plan_c --var RZP_PLAN_500:plan_d --var RZP_PLAN_1000:plan_e
scripts.db:reset: rm -rf .wrangler/state/v3/d1 && wrangler d1 migrations apply trf-rupeefund --local && wrangler d1 migrations apply trf-rupeefund-post-launch --env post-launch --local
scripts.deploy:post-launch: pnpm run build:post-launch && wrangler deploy --env post-launch
